You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How many friends can Morgan invite to her birthday party? Morgan has $90 budgeted for her birthday party. Morgan and each of her friends will play one round of mini-golf. A round of mini-golf costs $5 per person. Morgan and each of her friends will have $5 in arcade tokens. Morgan and each of her friends will ride the go-karts twice, and each go-kart ride costs $10. Morgan will spend $40 on birthday decorations. Morgan will spend $25 on a birthday cake. Morgan plans to invite 4 friends to her birthday party. Each guest will receive a $3 party favor.
